mutations.name: a bare hex prefix is not resolved
kills: resolveDepositRef finds the one deposit a bare 8-hex prefix starts, in either case

mutations.name: a prefix under 8 hex digits is taken
kills: resolveDepositRef reports a prefix under 8 hex digits, a non-hex ref, or no match as unknown

mutations.name: an ambiguous prefix picks the first match
kills: resolveDepositRef lists every full id an ambiguous prefix matches

mutations.name: a gate id with a hex tail is read as a prefix
kills: resolveDepositRef marks an id of another item kind as not a deposit, even when its tail is hex

mutations.name: the deposit: form is not stripped
kills: resolveDepositRef finds the one deposit a deposit:-prefixed short prefix starts
